### Overview

This project investigates genomic divergence in *Pegoscapus* fig wasps and how it contributes to adaptation and speciation.

### Methods

-   Whole-genome sequencing (PacBio HiFi + Illumina)

-   Population genomics analyses (π, dXY, F_ST)

-   Selection scans across chemosensory genes
